links.outcome: Readability grade level of Copilot and Google Search infertility answers versus 8th-grade level
links.effect: Both GS and MC outputs had readability scores above the 8th-grade level; GS had higher ARI and FKGL than MC (p = 0.044); no differences on FRE, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau.
links.quote: Both GS and MC outputs had readability scores above the 8th-grade level, indicating advanced reading levels.

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability, understandability, and actionability of Microsoft Copilot responses to patient infertility queries compared to Google Search using standardized scoring tools (PEMAT-P, readability formulas).
